retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome group portrait anchored by a vibrant, multi-colored heraldic crest in the upper right corner.
triggerTerms: gritty monochrome group portrait with colorful crest
heraldic shield overlay on dark photography
excludeWhen: designs without a central graphic emblem

recipe.visualDefinition: A low-key, desaturated photograph of three figures in an urban setting, contrasted sharply by a saturated, circular graphic emblem featuring Irish cultural symbols and bold typography.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast monochrome photography vs. vibrant graphic emblem
Triangular composition of subjects leading to a top-right anchor
Rough photographic texture vs. clean vector lines in the crest
Dark, shadowed background emphasizing the foreground subjects
coreInvariants: A circular or shield-shaped emblem in the upper right quadrant
Inclusion of green, white, and orange tricolor elements within the graphic

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects arranged in a diagonal line from bottom-left to center-right, filling the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The colorful graphic crest in the top right corner acts as the primary focal point against the dark background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large foreground figure, moves up the diagonal line of the group, and rests on the bright emblem.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space in the upper left and behind the subjects to create depth and focus.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: White and yellow (emblem outlines and text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme contrast between the zero-saturation background and the high-saturation graphic element.

letterConstructionRules: Arched or path-following baselines within the crest
High-contrast outlines to separate text from background colors
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are warped to fit the curvature of the circular ribbons and shield shapes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold display fonts paired with smaller, secondary sans-serifs following circular paths.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed feel of the primary display text.
Provides the necessary slab-serif structure for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, gritty monochrome photograph of three men in urban attire (beanies, hats) in a low-angle, shadowed composition with a dark background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Create a vector crest featuring a central shield with a shamrock, surrounded by circular ribbons in green, white, and orange. Place bold, arched white text on the ribbons and top banner.

verificationChecks: Is the crest in the top right corner?
Is the photography desaturated or monochrome?
Does the crest contain the Irish tricolor colors?
Is the text arched and bold?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subjects

avoid: Muted or pastel colors in the crest

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the crest does not overlap the main subject's face
Check that the monochrome tones have deep blacks and bright whites
Verify the text in the crest is legible and follows the curve
Confirm the shamrock icon is simplified and graphic
recipe.reuseFormula: Gritty monochrome urban portrait + [Subject] + [Top-Right Heraldic Crest] + [Tricolor Palette]
